title: Min stack ops
statementMd:
Simulate a stack supporting `['push', x]`, `['pop']`, `['top']` and `['min']` (the minimum currently in the stack). Return the results of `top` and `min` operations in order. Pops and queries only happen on non-empty stacks.

**Example:** `min_stack_ops([["push", 3], ["push", 1], ["min"], ["pop"], ["min"], ["top…)` returns `[1, 3, 3]`.
hints: Store the running minimum next to each element.
